archetypes.name: White-Blue Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Ephara's Enlightenment: Target heroic creatures with Auras and tricks, protect the invested threat, and use evasion to close quickly.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Inspired
archetypes.plan: Build around Siren of the Silent Song: Tap inspired creatures safely in combat or with enablers, then profit when they untap while controlling the pace.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Minotaurs
archetypes.plan: Build around Ragemonger: Reduce Minotaur costs, curve tribal creatures into one another, and attack before slower decks stabilize.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Tribute
archetypes.plan: Build around Fanatic of Xenagos: Present difficult tribute choices with efficient creatures and maintain pressure whichever mode the opponent grants.

archetypes.name: Green-White Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Reap What Is Sown: Target heroic creatures with efficient tricks, spread counters across the team, and win creature combat through growth.
